授業科目の概要.科目名称: Health & Wellness in Japan: An International Perspective
授業科目の概要.講義題目: Health and Wellness in Japan: A Sociological Perspective
授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項: This course is available to all degree-seeking students at Kyushu University, including both domestic and international students, as well as exchange students participating in university-wide student exchange agreements.

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）:
目まぐるしく変動し不確実性に特徴付けられる今日の社会情勢において、個人の健康とウェルネスの重要性はますます高まっている。この科目では、社会学的観点に基づき、現代日本社会における健康とウェルネスの基本的な特徴と課題を議論する。国際比較論のアプローチにより、国際社会における日本の特徴をより効果的に浮き彫りにしていく。
主なトピックとして、健康寿命、保健政策、食育、違法ドラッグ、自殺防止、過労死、医療・健康技術、高齢者介護などの傾向や課題に着目する。日本のケースの理解にとどまらず、これらの知識にもとづいた他国へのレッスンを学び取ることが、主な学習目的の一つである。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
Health and wellness are of paramount importance for both individuals and society in the twenty-first century, particularly in our current climate of social change, risks, and uncertainty. This course introduces students to key issues related to health, wellness, and overall well-being in contemporary Japanese society from a sociological perspective. It also features international and cross-national viewpoints to examine the similarities and differences between Japan and other parts of the world.
The main topics covered in this course include longevity, health policy, food education, illicit drugs, suicide prevention, health technology, long-term care, and dementia, among others. Students will explore the lessons learned from Japan’s experiences, both positive and negative, to help other countries enhance their citizens' well-being in the coming decades.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Health, Wellness, Well-being, Japan, Policy, International
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件:
This course is conducted entirely in English and was originally designed for international and exchange students. However, domestic students, including those from Japan, are strongly encouraged to enroll as well. There is no specific level of English proficiency officially required for formal enrollment.
That said, if you are not a native English speaker, it's important to have a minimum level of English skills to successfully participate in and complete the course. We recommend that students possess a minimum TOEFL score of 79 (IBT) or an IELTS score of 6.0.
